newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat to slightly weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat to slightly weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha was slightly weaker in line with falling crude prices in a quiet market, traders said.
April swaps were quoted lower at around $193/$194 cif NWE, against $196.50/$197 levels late on Wednesday, traders said.
A small contango remained in place with May quoted at $194/$195.
A large player said he would consider buying good quality material at around $187/88 cif NWE.
Traders attributed the falls to weaker crude prices and a lack of demand.
"There isn't that much material about but at the same time most people are covered and there isn't that much demand.
